name: blueprint/habit-tracker
description: Streaks with reminders: one store record per habit-day, a daily cue event, the due check delivers, a miss is a record not a failure
recipe: log the habit for today -> scan the streak (consecutive dates) -> schedule tomorrow's cue event -> due check delivers and marks notified - a missed day stays a gap in the record
pitfalls: a streak is consecutive dates - the scan, not a counter field
a miss is a record (the gap), not an error
due marks notified at return time - exactly-once is the state flip
